title: The Battle of Sutjeska
writer: Branimir Scepanovic, Sergey Bondarchuk, Predrag Golubovic
actors: Richard Burton, Ljuba Tadic, Velimir 'Bata' Zivojinovic
plot: In 1943, 20,000 Yugoslav partisans led by Tito find themselves encircled by 120,000 well-armed Axis troops in the mountains of Bosnia and must break out of encirclement.
